# SkySets.org

> Fan-built setlist archive for Sturgill Simpson and Johnny Blue Skies & The Dark Clouds, covering every show from 2005 to tonight.

SkySets.org tracks setlists, song statistics, tour data, show photos and posters. It's an independent fan project — free, with no ads, subscriptions or paywalls — and isn't affiliated with the artist, their label or management.

## Key pages

- [Home / Search](https://www.skysets.org/): Search and browse every show, filter by year, venue, state or country.
- [Upcoming Shows](https://www.skysets.org/upcoming-shows): Confirmed future tour dates.
- [Past Shows](https://www.skysets.org/past-shows): Every show already played, newest first.
- [Tour Stats](https://www.skysets.org/tour-stats): Song counts, debuts, rarest songs and album breakdowns per tour.
- [Discography](https://www.skysets.org/discography): Studio albums and their tracklists.
- [Members Directory](https://www.skysets.org/members): Fans who contribute setlists, photos and corrections.
- [Links](https://www.skysets.org/links): Official artist links and community resources.

## About

- [About](https://www.skysets.org/about): Who runs the site, where the data comes from, and how to get in touch.
- [FAQ](https://www.skysets.org/faq): Answers to common questions about the archive.
- [How to Use](https://www.skysets.org/how-to-use): A guide to searching, filtering and contributing.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.skysets.org/privacy): How visitor data is handled.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.skysets.org/terms): Terms governing use of the site.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.skysets.org/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexed show pages.
